author: Yum_FriedChicken
body:
Hello everyone, I have been just playing a bit of Nebula and Nexus recently, and I thought that I would like to make a map.
However I would like someone to help me; someone who is experienced with map making, and has done this before.
Also, I will be needing a build server to build the map onto, and will need to download link. If anyone has any information for me, please leave a comment on this thread saying so.

Thank you everyone!
-Max

replies.author: Cyrus49
replies.body: Hi Vladthesexy100, I am not experienced with mapmaking, but i can provide a server for you. The server will only be open when requested and you will have to have logmein hamanchi(Until the end of this month). It will have worldedit, and unless your making a map with a ton of blocks (like the old map fantasy(orcs  v. elves))It shouldn't lag. I can also help you build the map with WE/Creative  or give you my opinion on the map.
